name: @pondpilot/flowscope-core
description: SQL lineage analysis engine for the browser

scripts.build: yarn build:wasm && yarn sync:wasm-src && tsc && yarn copy:wasm
scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build ../../crates/flowscope-wasm --target web --out-dir ../../packages/core/wasm && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('../../packages/core/wasm/.gitignore', '# Keep wasm artifacts available for publishing\n')"
scripts.copy:wasm: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const src='wasm'; const dst=path.join('dist','wasm'); fs.rmSync(dst,{recursive:true,force:true}); fs.mkdirSync(dst,{recursive:true}); const copy=(s,d)=>{ for (const ent of fs.readdirSync(s,{withFileTypes:true})) { const sp=path.join(s,ent.name); const dp=path.join(d,ent.name); if(ent.isDirectory()) { fs.mkdirSync(dp,{recursive:true}); copy(sp,dp); } else { fs.copyFileSync(sp,dp); } } }; copy(src,dst);"
scripts.copy:wasm_OLD: rm -rf dist/wasm && mkdir -p dist/wasm && cp -R wasm/* dist/wasm/
scripts.sync:wasm-src: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const src='wasm'; const dst=path.join('src','wasm'); fs.rmSync(dst,{recursive:true,force:true}); fs.mkdirSync(dst,{recursive:true}); const copy=(s,d)=>{ for (const ent of fs.readdirSync(s,{withFileTypes:true})) { const sp=path.join(s,ent.name); const dp=path.join(d,ent.name); if(ent.isDirectory()) { fs.mkdirSync(dp,{recursive:true}); copy(sp,dp); } else { fs.copyFileSync(sp,dp); } } }; copy(src,dst);"
